purpose: Create business-neutral form drafts, immutable releases, release status, operation receipts, and transactional Outbox facts.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema and empty tables only.
dataImpact: No form fields, submissions, CRM data, roles, or routes are seeded.
recovery: Roll back application code while retaining published historical artifacts; restore only before first use.
forwardFix: Before first application this reserved migration may be corrected during review; after application use a new reviewed forward migration.
